title: ao-go project set-config --model REPLACES entire config (destructive footgun)
description:
Context:
- Source: sidekick mission minimax-fork-pr-and-cleanup, lane E, 2026-07-12. Evidence: /tmp/agent-orchestrator/sidekick/minimax-fork-pr-and-cleanup/evidence/E-worldarchitect-migration.md §5c.
- Current head: canonical @ 879c4355
- Repro on Linux: /home/jleechan/.local/bin/ao-go project set-config worldarchitect.ai --model sonnet --json
- Finding: ao-go project set-config's single-field flags (--model, --permission, --orchestrator-agent, --worker-agent, etc.) REPLACE the entire project config rather than MERGE with the existing values. After --model sonnet on worldarchitect.ai, the resulting config lost defaultBranch, sessionPrefix, permissions, worker.agent, orchestrator, and trackerIntake.

Why it matters:
- This is a destructive footgun: anyone using the new global provider-settings approach and then trying to tweak a single project field via --model/--permission will silently lose sessionPrefix (turning wa-N session IDs into nameless ones), defaultBranch (breaking worktree creation), permissions (forcing the default permission prompt mode), and worker.agent (reverting to claude-code default or whatever fallback). The migration today had to be rescued with an explicit --config-json re-application when the negative smoke test ran --model sonnet.

Implementation:
- File: backend/internal/cli/project.go (set-config command)
- Either:
  (a) Change single-field flags to MERGE into existing config instead of REPLACE, OR
  (b) Add a --merge flag (default off for backward compat) that switches behavior, OR
  (c) Make --model/--permission/--orchestrator-agent/--worker-agent explicitly safe-by-merge while keeping --config-json as the destructive explicit option.
- Recommendation: (c) is the safest backward-compatible change — single-field flags preserve other fields, --config-json remains explicit destructive. This matches user intuition that "set the model field" should only touch the model field.
- Current API signatures (from project.go set-config):
  func setConfigCmd() *cobra.Command
  // flags: --config-json, --clear, --default-branch, --env, --model, --orchestrator-agent, --permission, --post-create, --session-prefix, --symlink, --tracker-assignee, --tracker-intake, --tracker-repo, --worker-agent
- Call-site shape: ao-go project set-config worldarchitect.ai --model sonnet should produce a config that has model:sonnet AND retains sessionPrefix:wa, defaultBranch:main, permissions:bypass-permissions, worker.agent:claude-code, etc.

Constraints:
- --config-json must remain destructive (it's the explicit "wipe and replace" path).
- --clear must remain destructive (that's its purpose).
- Single-field flags should merge over existing values, not overwrite.
- Backward compatible: existing users of single-field flags (without --config-json) who relied on destructive behavior will see MORE fields preserved, not fewer — should be safe.

Non-goals: no support for fine-grained merge semantics (e.g. "merge only this subtree"). No removal of --config-json.

Forbidden paths: do not silently ignore single-field flags when they would conflict with --config-json. Do not introduce a --no-merge opt-out.

Acceptance criteria:
- Standards: ao-go project set-config --help documents the merge behavior for single-field flags.
- Static checks: go build ./... clean, go vet ./... clean.
- Tests: existing set-config tests still pass; add one test that --model on a project with full existing config preserves sessionPrefix, defaultBranch, permissions, worker.agent.
- Evidence: ao-go project set-config worldarchitect.ai --model sonnet → ao-go project get worldarchitect.ai shows sessionPrefix=wa, defaultBranch=main, permissions=bypass-permissions all preserved.
